i < live; ++i) {\n            if (i == best_pos) continue;\n            const double dx = cx[i] - mx;\n            const double dy = cy[i] - my;\n            const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            const double nd = md[i] > d ? md[i] : d;\n            if (nd < threshold_sq) {\n                idx[w] = idx[i];\n                cx[w] = cx[i];\n                cy[w] = cy[i];\n                md[w] = nd;\n                if (nd < next_d) {\n                    next_d = nd;\n                    next_pos = w;\n                }\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        live = w;\n        best_pos = next_pos;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(out.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double threshold_sq = threshold * threshold;\n    const Point* pts = points.data();\n\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices[i] = i;\n    }\n\n    // Candidate cluster of each seed, cached across rounds. So a cached result only becomes stale when one of its own\n    // members gets clustered.\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cached_members(N);\n    std::vector<char> stale(N, 1);\n\n    const int num_threads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<Scratch> scratch(num_threads);\n    for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {\n        scratch[t].resize(N);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<char> newly_clustered(N, 0);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        const int* seeds = unclustered_indices.data();\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n\n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed, in parallel.\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            Scratch& s = scratch[omp_get_thread_num()];\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                int cardinality;\n                if (stale[seed]) {\n                    cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, pts, threshold_sq,\n                                                           N, s, cached_members[seed]);\n                    stale[seed] = 0;\n                } else {\n                    cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                }\n\n                // Lowest seed index wins ties, matching the sequential scan.\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = cached_members[best_seed];\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        const std::vector<int>& winners = clusters.back().members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        // Invalidate every cached candidate cluster that contains a point which\n        // just became unavailable.\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            const int seed = seeds[i];\n            if (clustered[seed] || stale[seed]) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& m = cached_members[seed];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < m.size(); ++k) {\n                if (newly_clustered[m[k]]) {\n                    stale[seed] = 1;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list, releasing their caches\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 0;\n            std::vector<int>().swap(cached_members[winners[i]]);\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}","originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - OpenMP Parallel Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization: the search over all candidate seeds in a clustering round is\n// embarrassingly parallel, so it is distributed over OpenMP threads with a\n// dynamic schedule (per-seed cost varies strongly). i < live; ++i) {\n            if (i == best_pos) continue;\n            const double dx = cx[i] - mx;\n            const double dy = cy[i] - my;\n            const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            const double nd = md[i] > d ? md[i] : d;\n            if (nd < threshold_sq) {\n                idx[w] = idx[i];\n                cx[w] = cx[i];\n                cy[w] = cy[i];\n                md[w] = nd;\n                if (nd < next_d) {\n                    next_d = nd;\n                    next_pos = w;\n                }\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        live = w;\n        best_pos = next_pos;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(out.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double threshold_sq = threshold * threshold;\n    const Point* pts = points.data();\n\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; A seed's candidate\n    // cluster is a deterministic function of the seed and the set of available\n    // points; removing points that the greedy never selected cannot change any\n    // of its choices. So a cached result only becomes stale when one of its own\n    // members gets clustered.\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cached_members(N);\n    std::vector<char> stale(N, 1);\n\n    const int num_threads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<Scratch> scratch(num_threads);\n    for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {\n        scratch[t].resize(N);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<char> newly_clustered(N, 0);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        const int* seeds = unclustered_indices.data();\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n\n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed, in parallel.\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            Scratch& s = scratch[omp_get_thread_num()];\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                int cardinality;\n                if (stale[seed]) {\n                    cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, pts, threshold_sq,\n                                                           N, s, cached_members[seed]);\n                    stale[seed] = 0;\n                } else {\n                    cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                }\n\n                // Lowest seed index wins ties, matching the sequential scan.\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = cached_members[best_seed];\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        const std::vector<int>& winners = clusters.back().members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        // Invalidate every cached candidate cluster that contains a point which\n        // just became unavailable.\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            const int seed = seeds[i];\n            if (clustered[seed] || stale[seed]) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& m = cached_members[seed];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < m.size(); ++k) {\n                if (newly_clustered[m[k]]) {\n                    stale[seed] = 1;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list, releasing their caches\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 0;\n            std::vector<int>().swap(cached_members[winners[i]]);\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; Ties are resolved\n// deterministically (lowest seed index wins), matching the sequential order.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Per-thread scratch space for candidate cluster generation.\n// The candidate set is kept as a structure of arrays so the hot update loop\n// streams contiguous memory instead of gathering through point indices.\nstruct Scratch {\n    std::vector<int> idx;      // original point index of each live candidate\n    std::vector<double> cx;    // candidate coordinates\n    std::vector<double> cy;\n    std::vector<double> md;    // squared max distance from candidate to cluster members\n\n    void resize(int n) {\n        idx.resize(n);\n        cx.resize(n);\n        cy.resize(n);\n        md.resize(n);\n    }\n};\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `out`.\n//\n// This is the same greedy as the reference implementation, but instead of\n// recomputing the distance from every candidate to every member on each step it\n// keeps a running maximum per candidate (max is exact in floating point, so the\n// selected points are identical). Candidates whose running maximum reaches the\n// threshold can never be admitted later, so they are dropped from the working\n// set, which shrinks the per-step scan dramatically. Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed_point) continue;\n        const double dx = points[c].x - sx;\n        const double dy = points[c].y - sy;\n        const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n        if (d < threshold_sq) {\n            idx[live] = c;\n            cx[live] = points[c].x;\n            cy[live] = points[c].y;\n            md[live] = d;\n            if (d < best_d) {\n                best_d = d;\n                best_pos = live;\n            }\n            ++live;\n        }\n    }\n\n    out.clear();\n    out.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    // Iteratively absorb the candidate with the smallest cluster diameter.\n    while (best_pos >= 0) {\n        const int member = idx[best_pos];\n        const double mx = cx[best_pos];\n        const double my = cy[best_pos];\n        out.push_back(member);\n\n        // Single fused pass: update running maxima, compact out candidates that\n        // can no longer be admitted, and pick the next best candidate.\n        // Compaction is stable, so the array stays sorted by point index and\n        // ties keep resolving to the lowest index.\n        int w = 0;\n        int next_pos = -1;\n        double next_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int i = 0; i < live; ++i) {\n            if (i == best_pos) continue;\n            const double dx = cx[i] - mx;\n            const double dy = cy[i] - my;\n            const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            const double nd = md[i] > d ? md[i] : d;\n            if (nd < threshold_sq) {\n                idx[w] = idx[i];\n                cx[w] = cx[i];\n                cy[w] = cy[i];\n                md[w] = nd;\n                if (nd < next_d) {\n                    next_d = nd;\n                    next_pos = w;\n                }\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        live = w;\n        best_pos = next_pos;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(out.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double threshold_sq = threshold * threshold;\n    const Point* pts = points.data();\n\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices[i] = i;\n    }\n\n    // Candidate cluster of each seed, cached across rounds. A seed's candidate\n    // cluster is a deterministic function of the seed and the set of available\n    // points; removing points that the greedy never selected cannot change any\n    // of its choices. So a cached result only becomes stale when one of its own\n    // members gets clustered.\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cached_members(N);\n    std::vector<char> stale(N, 1);\n\n    const int num_threads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<Scratch> scratch(num_threads);\n    for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {\n        scratch[t].resize(N);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<char> newly_clustered(N, 0);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        const int* seeds = unclustered_indices.data();\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n\n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed, in parallel.\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            Scratch& s = scratch[omp_get_thread_num()];\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                int cardinality;\n                if (stale[seed]) {\n                    cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, pts, threshold_sq,\n                                                           N, s, cached_members[seed]);\n                    stale[seed] = 0;\n                } else {\n                    cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                }\n\n                // Lowest seed index wins ties, matching the sequential scan.\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; Ties are resolved\n// deterministically (lowest seed index wins), matching the sequential order.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Per-thread scratch space for candidate cluster generation.\n// The candidate set is kept as a structure of arrays so the hot update loop\n// streams contiguous memory instead of gathering through point indices.\nstruct Scratch {\n    std::vector<int> idx;      // original point index of each live candidate\n    std::vector<double> cx;    // candidate coordinates\n    std::vector<double> cy;\n    std::vector<double> md;    // squared max distance from candidate to cluster members\n\n    void resize(int n) {\n        idx.resize(n);\n        cx.resize(n);\n        cy.resize(n);\n        md.resize(n);\n    }\n};\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `out`.\n//\n// This is the same greedy as the reference implementation, but instead of\n// recomputing the distance from every candidate to every member on each step it\n// keeps a running maximum per candidate (max is exact in floating point, so the\n// selected points are identical). Candidates whose running maximum reaches the\n// threshold can never be admitted later, so they are dropped from the working\n// set, which shrinks the per-step scan dramatically. Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed_point) continue;\n        const double dx = points[c].x - sx;\n        const double dy = points[c].y - sy;\n        const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n        if (d < threshold_sq) {\n            idx[live] = c;\n            cx[live] = points[c].x;\n            cy[live] = points[c].y;\n            md[live] = d;\n            if (d < best_d) {\n                best_d = d;\n                best_pos = live;\n            }\n            ++live;\n        }\n    }\n\n    out.clear();\n    out.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    // Iteratively absorb the candidate with the smallest cluster diameter.\n    while (best_pos >= 0) {\n        const int member = idx[best_pos];\n        const double mx = cx[best_pos];\n        const double my = cy[best_pos];\n        out.push_back(member);\n\n        // Single fused pass: update running maxima, compact out candidates that\n        // can no longer be admitted, and pick the next best candidate.\n        // Compaction is stable, so the array stays sorted by point index and\n        // ties keep resolving to the lowest index.\n        int w = 0;\n        int next_pos = -1;\n        double next_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int i = 0; i < live; ++i) {\n            if (i == best_pos) continue;\n            const double dx = cx[i] - mx;\n            const double dy = cy[i] - my;\n            const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            const double nd = md[i] > d ? md[i] : d;\n            if (nd < threshold_sq) {\n                idx[w] = idx[i];\n                cx[w] = cx[i];\n                cy[w] = cy[i];\n                md[w] = nd;\n                if (nd < next_d) {\n                    next_d = nd;\n                    next_pos = w;\n                }\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        live = w;\n        best_pos = next_pos;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(out.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double threshold_sq = threshold * threshold;\n    const Point* pts = points.data();\n\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices[i] = i;\n    }\n\n    // Candidate cluster of each seed, cached across rounds. A seed's candidate\n    // cluster is a deterministic function of the seed and the set of available\n    // points; removing points that the greedy never selected cannot change any\n    // of its choices. So a cached result only becomes stale when one of its own\n    // members gets clustered.\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cached_members(N);\n    std::vector<char> stale(N, 1);\n\n    const int num_threads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<Scratch> scratch(num_threads);\n    for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {\n        scratch[t].resize(N);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<char> newly_clustered(N, 0);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        const int* seeds = unclustered_indices.data();\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n\n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed, in parallel.\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            Scratch& s = scratch[omp_get_thread_num()];\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                int cardinality;\n                if (stale[seed]) {\n                    cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, pts, threshold_sq,\n                                                           N, s, cached_members[seed]);\n                    stale[seed] = 0;\n                } else {\n                    cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                }\n\n                // Lowest seed index wins ties, matching the sequential scan.\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; Ties are resolved\n// deterministically (lowest seed index wins), matching the sequential order.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Per-thread scratch space for candidate cluster generation.\n// The candidate set is kept as a structure of arrays so the hot update loop\n// streams contiguous memory instead of gathering through point indices.\nstruct Scratch {\n    std::vector<int> idx;      // original point index of each live candidate\n    std::vector<double> cx;    // candidate coordinates\n    std::vector<double> cy;\n    std::vector<double> md;    // squared max distance from candidate to cluster members\n\n    void resize(int n) {\n        idx.resize(n);\n        cx.resize(n);\n        cy.resize(n);\n        md.resize(n);\n    }\n};\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster; members are written to `out`.\n//\n// This is the same greedy as the reference implementation, but instead of\n// recomputing the distance from every candidate to every member on each step it\n// keeps a running maximum per candidate (max is exact in floating point, so the\n// selected points are identical). Candidates whose running maximum reaches the\n// threshold can never be admitted later, so they are dropped from the working\n// set, which shrinks the per-step scan dramatically. Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed_point) continue;\n        const double dx = points[c].x - sx;\n        const double dy = points[c].y - sy;\n        const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n        if (d < threshold_sq) {\n            idx[live] = c;\n            cx[live] = points[c].x;\n            cy[live] = points[c].y;\n            md[live] = d;\n            if (d < best_d) {\n                best_d = d;\n                best_pos = live;\n            }\n            ++live;\n        }\n    }\n\n    out.clear();\n    out.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    // Iteratively absorb the candidate with the smallest cluster diameter.\n    while (best_pos >= 0) {\n        const int member = idx[best_pos];\n        const double mx = cx[best_pos];\n        const double my = cy[best_pos];\n        out.push_back(member);\n\n        // Single fused pass: update running maxima, compact out candidates that\n        // can no longer be admitted, and pick the next best candidate.\n        // Compaction is stable, so the array stays sorted by point index and\n        // ties keep resolving to the lowest index.\n        int w = 0;\n        int next_pos = -1;\n        double next_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int i = 0; i < live; ++i) {\n            if (i == best_pos) continue;\n            const double dx = cx[i] - mx;\n            const double dy = cy[i] - my;\n            const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            const double nd = md[i] > d ? md[i] : d;\n            if (nd < threshold_sq) {\n                idx[w] = idx[i];\n                cx[w] = cx[i];\n                cy[w] = cy[i];\n                md[w] = nd;\n                if (nd < next_d) {\n                    next_d = nd;\n                    next_pos = w;\n                }\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        live = w;\n        best_pos = next_pos;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(out.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double threshold_sq = threshold * threshold;\n    const Point* pts = points.data();\n\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices[i] = i;\n    }\n\n    // Candidate cluster of each seed, cached across rounds. A seed's candidate\n    // cluster is a deterministic function of the seed and the set of available\n    // points; removing points that the greedy never selected cannot change any\n    // of its choices. So a cached result only becomes stale when one of its own\n    // members gets clustered.\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cached_members(N);\n    std::vector<char> stale(N, 1);\n\n    const int num_threads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<Scratch> scratch(num_threads);\n    for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {\n        scratch[t].resize(N);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<char> newly_clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> todo;\n    todo.reserve(N);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        const int* seeds = unclustered_indices.data();\n\n        // Seeds whose cached candidate cluster has to be (re)built. Keeping\n        // these in their own compact list means the expensive dynamically\n        // scheduled loop only iterates over real work, instead of hammering the\n        // shared loop counter for thousands of cache hits every round.\n        todo.clear();\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            if (stale[seeds[i]]) todo.push_back(seeds[i]);\n        }\n        const int num_todo = static_cast<int>(todo.size());\n        const int* todo_seeds = todo.data();\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            Scratch& s = scratch[omp_get_thread_num()];\n\n            // Build the missing candidate clusters. Per-seed cost varies by\n            // orders of magnitude, hence the fine-grained dynamic schedule.\n            #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_todo; ++i) {\n                const int seed = todo_seeds[i];\n                generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, pts, threshold_sq,\n                                         N, s, cached_members[seed]);\n                stale[seed] = 0;\n            }\n\n            // Pick the largest candidate cluster; lowest seed index wins ties,\n            // matching the sequential ascending scan.\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                const int cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = cached_members[best_seed];\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        const std::vector<int>& winners = clusters.back().members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        // Invalidate every cached candidate cluster that contains a point which\n        // just became unavailable. Every member of a candidate cluster lies\n        // within `threshold` of its seed, so two clusters whose seeds are at\n        // least 2*threshold apart cannot share a point and can be skipped\n        // outright.\n        const double wx = pts[best_seed].x;\n        const double wy = pts[best_seed].y;\n        const double reach_sq = 4.0 * threshold_sq;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            const int seed = seeds[i];\n            if (clustered[seed] || stale[seed]) continue;\n            const double dx = pts[seed].x - wx;\n            const double dy = pts[seed].y - wy;\n            if (dx * dx + dy * dy >= reach_sq) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& m = cached_members[seed];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < m.size(); ++k) {\n                if (newly_clustered[m[k]]) {\n                    stale[seed] = 1;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list, releasing their caches\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 0;\n            std::vector<int>().swap(cached_members[winners[i]]);\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Compute cluster diameters in parallel, then report them in order\n    const int num_clusters = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(num_clusters, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < num_clusters; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; Ties are resolved\n// deterministically (lowest seed index wins), matching the sequential order.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? Candidates whose running maximum reaches the\n// threshold can never be admitted later, so they are dropped from the working\n// set, which shrinks the per-step scan dramatically. Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed_point) continue;\n        const double dx = points[c].x - sx;\n        const double dy = points[c].y - sy;\n        const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n        if (d < threshold_sq) {\n            idx[live] = c;\n            cx[live] = points[c].x;\n            cy[live] = points[c].y;\n            md[live] = d;\n            if (d < best_d) {\n                best_d = d;\n                best_pos = live;\n            }\n            ++live;\n        }\n    }\n\n    out.clear();\n    out.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    // Iteratively absorb the candidate with the smallest cluster diameter.\n    while (best_pos >= 0) {\n        const int member = idx[best_pos];\n        const double mx = cx[best_pos];\n        const double my = cy[best_pos];\n        out.push_back(member);\n\n        // Single fused pass: update running maxima, compact out candidates that\n        // can no longer be admitted, and pick the next best candidate.\n        // Compaction is stable, so the array stays sorted by point index and\n        // ties keep resolving to the lowest index.\n        int w = 0;\n        int next_pos = -1;\n        double next_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int i = 0; Keeping\n        // these in their own compact list means the expensive dynamically\n        // scheduled loop only iterates over real work, instead of hammering the\n        // shared loop counter for thousands of cache hits every round.\n        todo.clear();\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            if (stale[seeds[i]]) todo.push_back(seeds[i]);\n        }\n        const int num_todo = static_cast<int>(todo.size());\n        const int* todo_seeds = todo.data();\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            Scratch& s = scratch[omp_get_thread_num()];\n\n            // Build the missing candidate clusters. Per-seed cost varies by\n            // orders of magnitude, hence the fine-grained dynamic schedule.\n            #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_todo; ++i) {\n                const int seed = todo_seeds[i];\n                generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, pts, threshold_sq,\n                                         N, s, cached_members[seed]);\n                stale[seed] = 0;\n            }\n\n            // Pick the largest candidate cluster; lowest seed index wins ties,\n            // matching the sequential ascending scan.\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                const int cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = cached_members[best_seed];\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        const std::vector<int>& winners = cluster.members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        // Invalidate every cached candidate cluster that contains a point which\n        // just became unavailable. Every member of a candidate cluster lies\n        // within `threshold` of its seed, so two clusters whose seeds are at\n        // least 2*threshold apart cannot share a point and can be skipped\n        // outright.\n        const double wx = pts[best_seed].x;\n        const double wy = pts[best_seed].y;\n        const double reach_sq = 4.0 * threshold_sq;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            const int seed = seeds[i];\n            if (clustered[seed] || stale[seed]) continue;\n            const double dx = pts[seed].x - wx;\n            const double dy = pts[seed].y - wy;\n            if (dx * dx + dy * dy >= reach_sq) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& m = cached_members[seed];\n            for (size_t k = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 0;\n            std::vector<int>().swap(cached_members[winners[i]]);\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Compute cluster diameters in parallel, then report them in order\n    const int num_clusters = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(num_clusters, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < num_clusters; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0; Keeping\n        // these in their own compact list means the expensive dynamically\n        // scheduled loop only iterates over real work, instead of hammering the\n        // shared loop counter for thousands of cache hits every round.\n        todo.clear();\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            if (stale[seeds[i]]) todo.push_back(seeds[i]);\n        }\n        const int num_todo = static_cast<int>(todo.size());\n        const int* todo_seeds = todo.data();\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            Scratch& s = scratch[omp_get_thread_num()];\n\n            // Build the missing candidate clusters. lowest seed index wins ties,\n            // matching the sequential ascending scan.\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                const int cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = cached_members[best_seed];\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        const std::vector<int>& winners = cluster.members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        // Invalidate every cached candidate cluster that contains a point which\n        // just became unavailable. Every member of a candidate cluster lies\n        // within `threshold` of its seed, so two clusters whose seeds are at\n        // least 2*threshold apart cannot share a point and can be skipped\n        // outright.\n        const double wx = pts[best_seed].x;\n        const double wy = pts[best_seed].y;\n        const double reach_sq = 4.0 * threshold_sq;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 0;\n            std::vector<int>().swap(cached_members[winners[i]]);\n        }\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Compute cluster diameters in parallel, then report them in order\n    const int num_clusters = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(num_clusters, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < num_clusters; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; Ties are resolved\n// deterministically (lowest seed index wins), matching the sequential order.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Per-thread scratch space for candidate cluster generation.\n// The candidate set is kept as a structure of arrays so the hot update loop\n// streams contiguous memory instead of gathering through point indices.\nstruct Scratch {\n    std::vector<int> idx; Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0; lowest seed index wins ties,\n            // matching the sequential ascending scan.\n            int local_card = -1;\n            int local_seed = -1;\n\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n                const int seed = seeds[i];\n                const int cardinality = static_cast<int>(cached_members[seed].size());\n                if (cardinality > local_card ||\n                    (cardinality == local_card && seed < local_seed)) {\n                    local_card = cardinality;\n                    local_seed = seed;\n                }\n            }\n\n            #pragma omp critical(qt_best)\n            {\n                if (local_card > max_cardinality ||\n                    (local_card == max_cardinality && local_seed < best_seed)) {\n                    max_cardinality = local_card;\n                    best_seed = local_seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = cached_members[best_seed];\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        const std::vector<int>& winners = cluster.members;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < winners.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n            newly_clustered[winners[i]] = 1;\n        }\n\n        // Invalidate every cached candidate cluster that contains a point which\n        // just became unavailable. Every member of a candidate cluster lies\n        // within `threshold` of its seed, so two clusters whose seeds are at\n        // least 2*threshold apart cannot share a point and can be skipped\n        // outright.\n        const double wx = pts[best_seed].x;\n        const double wy = pts[best_seed].y;\n        const double reach_sq = 4.0 * threshold_sq;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Per-thread scratch space for candidate cluster generation.\n// The candidate set is kept as a structure of arrays so the hot update loop\n// streams contiguous memory instead of gathering through point indices.\nstruct Scratch {\n    std::vector<int> idx; Candidates whose running maximum reaches the\n// threshold can never be admitted later, so they are dropped from the working\n// set, which shrinks the per-step scan dramatically. Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed_point) continue;\n        const double dx = points[c].x - sx;\n        const double dy = points[c].y - sy;\n        const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n        if (d < threshold_sq) {\n            idx[live] = c;\n            cx[live] = points[c].x;\n            cy[live] = points[c].y;\n            md[live] = d;\n            if (d < best_d) {\n                best_d = d;\n                best_pos = live;\n            }\n            ++live;\n        }\n    }\n\n    out.clear();\n    out.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    // Iteratively absorb the candidate with the smallest cluster diameter.\n    while (best_pos >= 0) {\n        const int member = idx[best_pos];\n        const double mx = cx[best_pos];\n        const double my = cy[best_pos];\n        out.push_back(member);\n\n        // Single fused pass: update running maxima, compact out candidates that\n        // can no longer be admitted, and pick the next best candidate.\n        // Compaction is stable, so the array stays sorted by point index and\n        // ties keep resolving to the lowest index.\n        int w = 0;\n        int next_pos = -1;\n        double next_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int i = 0; i < live; ++i) {\n            if (i == best_pos) continue;\n            const double dx = cx[i] - mx;\n            const double dy = cy[i] - my;\n            const double d = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            const double nd = md[i] > d ? md[i] : d;\n            if (nd < threshold_sq) {\n                idx[w] = idx[i];\n                cx[w] = cx[i];\n                cy[w] = cy[i];\n                md[w] = nd;\n                if (nd < next_d) {\n                    next_d = nd;\n                    next_pos = w;\n                }\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        live = w;\n        best_pos = next_pos;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(out.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double threshold_sq = threshold * threshold;\n    const Point* pts = points.data();\n\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; A seed's candidate\n    // cluster is a deterministic function of the seed and the set of available\n    // points; removing points that the greedy never selected cannot change any\n    // of its choices. So a cached result only becomes stale when one of its own\n    // members gets clustered.\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cached_members(N);\n    std::vector<char> stale(N, 1);\n\n    std::vector<Scratch> scratch(omp_get_max_threads());\n    std::vector<char> newly_clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> todo;\n    todo.reserve(N);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        const int* seeds = unclustered_indices.data();\n\n        // Seeds whose cached candidate cluster has to be (re)built. Comparisons are done on\n// squared distances, which is order-equivalent to comparing distances.\nstatic int generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                    const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                                    const Point* points,\n                                    const double threshold_sq,\n                                    const int point_count,\n                                    Scratch& s,\n                                    std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const double sx = points[seed_point].x;\n    const double sy = points[seed_point].y;\n\n    int* __restrict__ idx = s.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cx = s.cx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ cy = s.cy.data();\n    double* __restrict__ md = s.md.data();\n\n    // Seed the working set with every unclustered point within the threshold of\n    // the seed, tracking the closest one (lowest index wins ties, as in the\n    // sequential ascending scan).\n    int live = 0;\n    int best_pos = -1;\n    double best_d = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    for (int c = 0;
